_nguon: Stage 2 — Orthogonal Three-Pillar Life & Business Advisor KB (English overlay). Reviewed by the project owner 2026-11-26 (bien_tap).
ket: The three views below each read one side of the same decision: your own capacity, timing and space. They are not merged into one verdict, and the decision stays yours.

lop_ten.tuvi_phi_hoa: Zi Wei Dou Shu & Liang Flying Transformations
lop_ten.hoang_lich_30_ngay: Almanac day selection month by month

bac_2.nhan: Add birth time & birthplace to unlock 12-Palace Zi Wei & Ji-to-Ji chains
bac_2.ly_do: Exact birth hour unlocks your BaZi Hour Pillar (both balancing methods) plus full Zi Wei Flying Transformations.

bac_3_nha.nhan: Add compass facing & construction year to unlock Period-9 Flying Stars
bac_3_nha.ly_do: Reveals the exact Mountain–Facing star pair at your entrance and Period-9 lighting/material harmony.

bac_3_doi_tac.nhan: Add partner or co-founder birth date
bac_3_doi_tac.ly_do: Shows whether they complement or duplicate your Five-Element profile so you can divide roles cleanly.

su_nghiep_chuyen_viec.diem_tua: Anchor your role in {hanh_can}-aligned strengths and your Personal Year {nam_cn} cadence.
su_nghiep_chuyen_viec.diem_giu: Avoid reactive career exits during consolidation months; keep at least a six-month living reserve.

tai_chinh_dau_tu.diem_tua: Rely on written unit-economics checklists and schedule key negotiations in Advance months.
tai_chinh_dau_tu.diem_giu: Never concentrate all liquidity into a single bet or rush into unverified commitments.

gop_von_hop_tac.diem_tua: Clear role boundaries and dual-approval spending thresholds protect both the venture and the friendship.
gop_von_hop_tac.diem_giu: Avoid placing both sales expansion and treasury control in one unchecked lane.

nha_cua_mat_bang.diem_tua: Prioritize bright airflow and orient your desk and bed-head with your {quai} trigram.
nha_cua_mat_bang.diem_giu: Keep monthly housing commitments within comfortable cashflow limits and avoid major drilling in Consolidate months.

tinh_cam_cam_ket.diem_tua: Steady, consistent small actions speak louder than grand promises right now.
tinh_cam_cam_ket.diem_giu: Avoid carrying work exhaustion or past grievances into late-night relationship talks.

gia_dao_hoa_giai.diem_tua: Warm shared meals, soft lighting and clear practical requests rebuild warmth quickly.
gia_dao_hoa_giai.diem_giu: Skip sensitive money or in-law debates late at night when energy is depleted.

suc_ben_nang_luong.diem_tua: Support {hanh_can}-aligned daily habits and keep your sleeping area quiet and airy.
suc_ben_nang_luong.diem_giu: Do not ignore persistent fatigue or postpone routine health checkups.

quyet_dinh_tong_hop.diem_tua: Pair {hanh_can}-supportive routines with your Advance months so effort lands cleanly.
quyet_dinh_tong_hop.diem_giu: Avoid launching more than two major commitments simultaneously.

nguon.thanso_nam: Numerology — Personal Year {n} (no birth hour, so no BaZi level is used)
nguon.lich_12: 12-month decision calendar (zodiac branch, annual star, solar terms{them})
nguon.menh_quai: Eight Mansions — your personal trigram (no house direction, so no level)
nguon.nam_hai_la_so: Zi Wei and BaZi readings — level for {nam} (This Year chapter, annual box)
nguon.mat_bang: Eight Mansions + Flying Stars — shop frontage (direction {do}°{nam})

mau.nhan_co_gio: In your BaZi reading, the “{chuong}” chapter is at {nhan_muc}. Element running low in your eight characters: {hanh}.
mau.nhan_khong_gio: Without a birth hour BaZi has six characters: the element running low is {hanh}. Personal Year {n}: {y}
mau.thien_co_gio: In your Zi Wei reading, the “{chuong}” chapter is at {nhan_muc}.
mau.thien_lich: Over the next 12 months, months to move forward: {mo}; months to conserve energy: {giu}.
mau.dia_khong_nha: Your trigram is {quai}; your Vitality direction is {huong}. Add your house direction to see a level for the home.
mau.dia_hd_khong_nha: For important work, you can sit facing {huong} and keep the spot bright and tidy.
mau.tong_cung: The views that give a level point the same way ({muc}). It is still one angle — decide by your real circumstances.
mau.tong_khac: The views disagree ({ds}). The system does not pick a side: each looks at one aspect, and you weigh them against your real circumstances.
mau.tong_mot: Only one view can give a level ({ds}); add a birth hour or house direction for more angles.
mau.doi_tac: The other person leans toward the “{vai}” role ({hanh}): {gia_tri}. Agree in writing who owns which part; this is not a compatibility score.
mau.doi_tac_tieu_de: Which role the other person leans toward

chuyen_huong.nguoi_khac: This question is about someone else. The advisor only reads your own birth date, so it does not answer for that person. To look at two people, use the two-person chart — the other person should enter their own details or agree to you entering them.
chuyen_huong.ke_su_viec: It sounds like this has already happened. A chart cannot judge what already happened; first steady yourself, talk to someone you trust and, if money or legal matters are involved, ask a qualified professional. When you are ready, you can ask about your own next step.
chuyen_huong.chua_ro: The advisor could not tell what you are deciding. Pick the closest topic below, or ask directly in each practice's Q&A.
chuyen_huong.duoi_tuoi: The decision advisor is for people aged 16 and over. For younger people, parents can read the child's BaZi or Zi Wei pages, written for parents.

mo_cua_hang.can: keeping cash flowing through the first months with no profit, and deciding small daily matters quickly
mo_cua_hang.viec_nang: signing the lease, the first stock order, opening day
mo_cua_hang.giu: Keep at least 6 months of shop costs (rent, wages, stock) as a reserve, separate from living money; avoid a long lease before a trial run.
dieu_kien: A reserve covering 6 months of fixed costs, separate from the household's living money.
A lease stating term, price and right to renovate; if possible, trial-sell from a small stall or online first.
Settle the facing direction and the till position before renovating; changing it later usually costs twice as much.
mo_cua_hang.truoc_het: Work out your fixed monthly cost and how many months you can last without profit, then go and view premises.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: sign the lease, place the first stock order and open if the preparation is done.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: do the preparation (permits, suppliers, design, trial sales); no need to rush the main step.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: no long lease and no big stock order yet; use the time to review numbers and permits.

mo_quan.can: steady quality every day and tolerating quiet weeks at the start
mo_quan.viec_nang: signing the lease, buying kitchen equipment, opening day
mo_quan.giu: Count rent, wages and ingredients for at least 6 months; trial the menu and the footfall before buying large equipment.
dieu_kien: Capital for 6 months of rent, wages and ingredients while the place is quiet.
Business and food-safety permits done before opening day.
Run the menu and a peak hour for 1–2 weeks with regular guests before opening officially.
mo_quan.truoc_het: Work out how many portions you must sell per day to break even, then ask whether the area around the site has enough customers.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: sign the lease, buy equipment and open if the trial menu went well.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: do permits, choose suppliers, trial the menu; no need to rush the opening date.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: no big equipment, no long lease; use the time to recount costs.

mo_rong.can: the current outlet running steadily even when the owner is away
mo_rong.viec_nang: signing for the new site, hiring, opening day
mo_rong.giu: Open another site only when the current one has been profitable for several months without depending on you alone.
dieu_kien: The current outlet profitable for at least 3–6 months in a row.
A trained manager for the new site, so you are not running between two places.
New-site costs covered for at least 6 months if revenue falls short.
mo_rong.truoc_het: Let the current outlet run for a week without you and see whether numbers and customers stay steady.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: sign the new site and hire if the old outlet already runs steadily.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: survey locations, cost it, train the manager; no need to sign in a hurry.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: strengthen the current outlet, do not sign a new site yet.

ra_lam_rieng.can: finding your own clients and tolerating months of uneven income
ra_lam_rieng.viec_nang: handing in notice (if employed), signing the first client, registering the business
ra_lam_rieng.giu: Keep at least 6 months of living money, and have at least one first client or contract before giving up your current income.
dieu_kien: Six months of living money for the household, kept apart from business capital.
At least one first client or contract, or run it alongside your job for 2–3 months before leaving it.
Talk with your household about the lowest income they can accept.
ra_lam_rieng.truoc_het: Run it alongside your current job and count what you earn over 2–3 months.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: sign the first client, register the business, announce the new work.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: run in parallel, find more clients, refine the offer; no need to drop your old income yet.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: keep your current income, avoid large commitments; just stay in touch with prospects.

chuyen_viec.can: being clear why you want to leave and whether the new place solves exactly that
chuyen_viec.viec_nang: accepting an offer, handing in notice
chuyen_viec.giu: Resign only after a written offer; read the probation, bonus and contract term carefully; do not decide out of momentary frustration.
dieu_kien: Write down three reasons for leaving and see how many the new place solves.
A written offer stating pay, probation and contract term.
Three months of living money in case probation does not work out.
chuyen_viec.truoc_het: Write down what you most want to change, then ask whether the new place changes exactly that.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: accept the offer, negotiate terms and give notice if everything is clear.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: update your profile, meet more people in the field, practise interviews; no need to decide in a hurry.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: do not give notice or sign an offer while terms are vague.

dau_tu.can: tolerating price swings without having to sell in a hurry
dau_tu.giu: Use only spare money set aside for this; this is not investment advice, so consult a qualified professional before committing a large sum.
dieu_kien: Spare money, not living money or short-term borrowing.
Know how large a fall makes you stop.
Split a large sum into several tranches instead of one.
dau_tu.truoc_het: Decide how much you can lose without hurting daily life, then choose the channel.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: commit in small tranches following a plan written in advance.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: study the channel and ask a professional; no need to commit in a hurry.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: no large commitment; hold cash and review the plan.

gop_von.can: being clear about roles and money from the start, even with relatives
gop_von.giu: Write down every contribution and authority, keep the business account separate; consult a lawyer before signing a large agreement.
dieu_kien: A document stating capital shares, each person's work, how profit is split and how to exit.
A business account separate from personal accounts; large sums need two approvals.
Each person says what they dislike doing, so nobody carries it in silence.
gop_von.truoc_het: Write one page: who puts in how much, who does what, and how it is settled if one person wants out.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: sign and transfer capital if both have read the document carefully.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: draft the agreement, divide roles, consult a lawyer; no need to transfer capital yet.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: do not sign or transfer yet; use the time to clarify roles.

mua_nha.can: a monthly payment that does not squeeze necessary spending
mua_nha.viec_nang: paying the deposit, signing the contract, taking over the home
mua_nha.giu: Check the legal status (title, zoning, disputes) in documents; pay a deposit only after reading the refund terms.
dieu_kien: Clean legal status: title, zoning, no disputes, checked with the competent authority.
The monthly payment (if borrowing) leaves room for necessary spending and a 6-month reserve.
Visit at two different times (daytime and evening) before paying a deposit.
mua_nha.truoc_het: Work out the monthly payment and what remains after paying it, then go and view homes.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: pay the deposit, sign and take over if the legal status is clean.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: view homes, check the legal status, work out the loan; no need to pay a deposit in a hurry.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: no deposit or signing yet; use the time to review documents.

tinh_cam.can: both people being able to say hard things and share the work together
tinh_cam.viec_nang: deciding to marry, moving in together
tinh_cam.giu: Decide by what the two of you have said to each other, not by the chart; for big legal or child matters consult a professional.
dieu_kien: Each person states the three things they need most and the three they cannot accept.
Talk about money, housing, children and both families before deciding.
Do not decide under pressure of age or outside opinion; allow enough time to know each other.
tinh_cam.truoc_het: Each person writes the three things they need most in the other, then compare.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: have the serious talk, meet both families, settle a plan if you both agree.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: talk steadily about money, housing, children; no need to fix a date yet.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: no big decision yet; listen to each other and meet more family.

gia_dao.ten: a family matter, easing tension at home
gia_dao.can: one person opening the conversation and hearing the other out first
gia_dao.viec_nang: the main conversation, asking a mediator
gia_dao.giu: Talk when calm, not when angry; if there is abuse or violence, seek professional support.
dieu_kien: Choose a moment when both are fine: after a meal, no rush, nobody else around.
Say what you feel rather than listing faults; listen fully before answering.
If needed, ask someone you both trust to sit in the middle.
gia_dao.truoc_het: Pick a calm moment this week and say one thing that bothers you, starting the sentence with “I”.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: open the bigger topic, bring in a mediator if needed.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: talk lightly and regularly, avoid piling up old matters.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: hold off heavy talk, keep the atmosphere calm.

suc_ben.can: enough sleep and separating work hours from rest
suc_ben.giu: See a doctor for long-term sleeplessness or unusual symptoms; a chart is not a substitute for a doctor.
dieu_kien: Sleep on time at least 5 nights a week and switch screens off before bed.
Drop one unimportant task from this week.
See a doctor if sleeplessness lasts over 2–3 weeks or tiredness comes with other symptoms.
suc_ben.truoc_het: Pick one task to drop this week and one fixed bedtime.

nen_lam.day_manh: Favourable month: take longer leave, lighten your work rhythm.
nen_lam.can_bang: Even-paced month: keep a steady bedtime and light exercise.
nen_lam.phong_thu: A month to slow down: cut workload, prioritise rest, see a doctor if tiredness lasts.

mat_bang.ly_do_nha_o: The direction you have is a residence's. If the shop is not in that same house, measure the shop's frontage separately; if the shop is the frontage of that residence, choose “The shop is in this same house”.

nha_o.nhan: Direction of the home you are considering
nha_o.ly_do_thieu: This question is about a home, so the main door direction of the house is needed (measure it with the compass or take it from Feng Shui).
